description: This source file defines the LogLocator enum, which provides static methods and properties for locating and managing log files within a specified directory. It includes functions to determine the latest log file, ensure the log directory exists, and retrieve paths for launchd configurations.

classes.name: LogLocator
classes.description: A utility enum for locating and managing log files within a specific directory, supporting environment overrides and path retrieval.

methods.name: logDir
methods.description: Computes the directory URL for logs, possibly overridden by an environment variable.

methods.name: stdoutLog
methods.description: Returns the URL for the stdout log file within the log directory.

methods.name: gatewayLog
methods.description: Returns the URL for the gateway log file within the log directory.

methods.name: ensureLogDirExists
methods.description: Creates the log directory if it does not already exist.

methods.name: modificationDate(for:)
methods.description: Retrieves the content modification date of a given URL, defaulting to distantPast if unavailable.

methods.name: bestLogFile
methods.description: Returns the most recently modified log file prefixed with 'openclaw' or nil if none exists.

methods.name: launchdLogPath
methods.description: Provides the filesystem path for launchd standard output/error logs.

methods.name: launchdGatewayLogPath
methods.description: Provides the filesystem path for gateway launchd logs.
